thread:
jess: heads up — noticed console authz telemetry for service-account keys is spiking cardinality, dashboards look noisy. linking current PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/482
raju: ugh yeah saw that. is it sampling or a tag explosion?
taylor: sampling — we started collecting full key_id for attribution in 2.7.0, which exploded unique series.
raju: ok, we need accurate attribution for billing/quotas but can't meltdown prometheus. any proposals?
mike: proposal A: hash key_id and store as key_bucket with 1k buckets. gives stable attribution without full cardinality. lower fidelity but preserves per-tenant split.
jess: can we do route-level sampling instead? e.g., full capture for admin routes, sampled for normal generate calls.
raju: route-level helps, but some customers hit many routes via proxies — we still get lots of buckets. mixing both might be best.
taylor: +1 to hashed buckets + route sampling. also add a short TTL so retired keys stop showing up in dashboards after 7d.
observability-bot: alert triggered: high label churn on `authz.requests` metric (rate 4200/min). threshold exceeded.
mike: here's a sample config I'm thinking — small canary first:
```
telemetry:
  authz:
    key_id:
      strategy: hashed_buckets
      buckets: 1024
      ttl_days: 7
    routes:
      default_sampling: 0.02
      admin_sampling: 1.0
      canary: true
      canary_percentage: 5
```
raju: looks sensible. need to document billing implications: hashed buckets will aggregate multiple keys to same bucket — cost attribution will be approximate. include a note in console UI.
jess: agree. UX asks: how do we surface sampling to customers? show a banner on the key details page and in the usage export: `sampling: 2%` and a link to docs.
taylor: rollback plan: if we see <95% correlation on known tenants after canary, auto-disable sampling and roll back. add a spike detector for error budgets.
mike: can we add a special tag when we hash, like `key_bucket=<hex>` so we can still pivot in logs? we have to avoid leaking full key_id.
raju: safe if bucket is irreversible. use HMAC with service salt, rotateable. store salt rotation metadata.
jess: timeline: canary tomorrow on staging -> 5% prod canary on Mon -> 100% by end of week if no regressions. who wants to own rollout playbook?
raju: I'll own playbook + dashboard panels. will add a quick diff panel comparing pre/post token counts.
taylor: I'll own console UX copy and billing note.
mike: I'll ship the config + infra change and monitor. will wire an alert to oncall.
observability-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry-authz-config v3 -> canary cluster at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: deploy started for telemetry-authz-config v3 (canary 5%) :rocket: 
jess: thanks team. please leave short thread updates as you hit each milestone. :thumbsup:
